title: GamesScriptStorageRequest
description: games.script-storage-request@1: game.storage.get(key), set(key, value), delete(key) and keys(prefix?) on the mod's key/value storage for its place (games.storage.kv): keys up to 128 bytes, values up to 8 KB of JSON, at most 1000 keys and 1 MB per mod per place.
